intro: The Crest of Lordaeron is a weathered historical artifact bearing the emblem of the fallen kingdom. With few such treasures surviving the Scourge's destruction, it is delivered to Oran Snakewrithe in Undercity to help preserve the Forsaken's past heritage.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A weathered crest depicting the mark of Lordaeron. With so few relics left after the kingdom's fall, someone in the Undercity would be very keen to get their hands on this.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What have you got there, adventurer? A tasty morsel?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well I'll be. A genuine relic of our home. Mostly intact, too. We need to be extra careful with this one.
Thank you for your aid in restoring our history, adventurer. I'll see to it that we take good care of this.

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
